vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jimeng-prompter
Version: 2.0.0

The jimeng-prompter skill is a well-structured prompt engineering tool designed to assist users in generating high-quality prompts for the Jimeng AI platform (Seedance and Seedream models). The instructions in SKILL.md and README.md define a clear multi-phase workflow involving requirement gathering, model routing, and production-ready output without any indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only Jimeng prompt-writing helper with no code or credential requirements, but users should be careful when providing reference photos, videos, or audio.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a prompt-engineering workflow for Jimeng image and video generation. Optional reference-media handling is purpose-aligned, but it can involve personal files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow is limited to asking staged questions, choosing a Jimeng model/prompt format, and producing prompts. It requires user confirmation before the final production prompt phase.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, no required binaries, no required environment variables, and no code files to execute.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may ask for user-selected reference images, videos, or audio to improve Jimeng outputs. This is aligned with the stated creative purpose but should be treated as sharing media with an AI workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential use, local indexing, privileged file access, or account mutation are declared or shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe to install as an instruction-only prompt helper. Before using reference-image or reference-video features, make sure you are comfortable sharing those files with the AI generation workflow and review Jimeng’s own data-handling terms if the media is private.

evidence.explanation: The skill may ask the user to provide selected reference media for use in Jimeng prompts. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but reference images, videos, or audio can contain sensitive personal information.
evidence.snippet: 即梦 Seedance 2.0 支持上传最多 12 个文件（9张图+3段视频+3段音频）... 有角色/人物照片 → 发给我，我会在提示词中用 @图1 引用

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only provide reference media you are comfortable sharing with the AI generation service, and remove or avoid sensitive personal content when possible.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If you provide photos, videos, or audio, that media may be used in the Jimeng generation workflow and could expose personal faces, locations, voices, or other private details.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: No artifact-backed shell execution, remote scripts, deceptive control behavior, autonomous destructive action, or hidden behavior was shown.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account permissions, privileged APIs, or delegated authority are requested or shown.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The only notable sensitive-data issue is optional user-provided reference media for Jimeng prompt collaboration.
